  > 
  > 1. **Coverage population.** `claims.py` on your main now separates the intervals (HC0 for Bernoulli, cluster bootstrap for cluster designs, unit bootstrap as the DM interval). The `c8_coverage*.csv` in `paper-repo/results/claims` is the older version that pools cluster cells under HC0 (2370 cells, mean 0.745), which the code docstring now calls not valid. The text currently quotes the 1800 Bernoulli cells that Fig 9 draws (mean 0.736; by |bias|/SD bins 0.925/0.919/0.868/0.668/0.158; by L quartile among low-bias cells 0.943/0.929/0.900/0.948; by family Stanford3 0.52, ego-Facebook 0.66, BA 0.74, DC-SBM 0.75, SBM 0.76, ER 0.80, WS 0.82). Please export the updated claims and confirm these (or give the population you want quoted), and say what the 1800 are (σ = 0.5, mechanisms (a)–(f), `pfine_` runs excluded?). The by-family file in the old export was at s = 0.5 only, so my earlier by-family numbers were mislabelled; they are replaced. Cluster designs: please give the cluster-bootstrap coverage so the text can say it in one sentence.
  > 2. **Outstanding from my earlier comment** (a–e on this issue): the d_target = 20 reduction for C5 (the text quotes only the BA d = 20 example), the s* prediction from the C1 formula (or "not done"), CIs for the constant rule and rule B, the fine-p result for (c), and the S_adj R² per holdout (−0.064 vs −0.006).
  > 3. **Appendix grid paragraph** (`paper/sections/appendix.tex`, "Grid") is written from `ANALYSIS_PLAN.md` §4 plus the run families in `cells.parquet` (129 runs). Please confirm it or correct it.
  >
